doc.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995

title: Upcoming plans: Junior Mance trio on the S.S. Norway cruise
summary: He looks ahead to a cruise with Junior Mance and Keter Betts, a fan's newsletter and other performers.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well what’s next up for you?
I like your attitude, I really do.

I anticipate something good. I know one good thing is coming up, I get a chance to be with my buddies Junior Mance and Keter Betts, in a couple of weeks. I’m really looking forward to that. We’re going to be on the jazz cruise, on the S.S. Norway.
Oh, there’s so many good people going to be there, oh, Lord.

Yeah. In fact I got a letter from a lady from Florida, she’s a real fan of ours now. She wrote a newsletter for the — St. Petersburg Florida — she says “Jack, we can’t wait for you to come down for the cruise. So she wrote down for the newsletter she was on that cruise with Oscar Peterson. She wrote some of the report on that.
Oh, I was on that cruise.

Yeah, Hilda, her name is, I forget— Hilda. She dropped me a note with the newsletter that she wrote and she mentioned what a wonderful concert that was with Oscar and everybody and all the different artists that were there. And she mentioned it. And I can’t wait for November the 4th, to hear one of my favorite groups, the Junior Mance trio, with Keter Betts and Jackie Williams. So we’re really looking forward to that. We had such a great success the last time we were on the, we played the Song, the American Song Book. And this time we’re going to do the Norway. And it’s going to be some great talent on there also.
I think Joe is going to be on that cruise.

Joe is going to be on that. I hope Joe is going to be, or is he on the one before us? Joe might be on the one before us I think. Because there are going to be two weeks. But we’re going to have some good people on ours also. I’m really looking forward to that. We have such a great rapport with Junior and Keter. I bet you could tell that on the record, huh?
